citation.authors: Bassami M, MacLaren DPM, Ahmadizad S, et al.
citation.title: Effects of Mixed Isoenergetic Meals on Fat and Carbohydrate Metabolism during Exercise in Older Men

population.description: Eight healthy older men (mean age 63.3 +/- 5.2 y, body mass 78.1 +/- 14.0 kg, height 168 cm, body fat 21 +/- 5.3%); HOMA2-IR and HOMA2-%B described by the authors as normal. BMI is not printed.

protocols.name: fasting
protocols.description: Overnight-fasted pre-meal blood sample of a laboratory visit at 08:00 (stated), drawn seated after 20 min rest (stated); the paper gives no fast length (only 'overnight') and no sample duration, so a 10 h fast and a 30 min run-in are assumed

findings.description: Fasting (pre-meal) plasma NEFA on the high-fat-meal visit, mean and SE; the same eight men were tested on each of four visits

location.where: Results, NEFA paragraph (pre-meal value of the 'from ... to ...' pair; Figure 1 pre-meal)
location.quote: Pre-exercise NEFA concentration increased significantly following HF (from 0.39 ± 0.08 to 0.61 ± 0.08 mmol/L)

findings.description: Fasting (pre-meal) plasma NEFA on the high-GI-meal visit, mean and SE; the same eight men were tested on each of four visits

location.where: Results, NEFA paragraph (pre-meal value of the 'from ... to ...' pair; Figure 1 pre-meal)
location.quote: decreased significantly after eating HGI (from 0.44 ± 0.09 to 0.13 ± 0.02 mmol/L)

findings.description: Fasting (pre-meal) plasma NEFA on the low-GI-meal visit, mean and SE; the same eight men were tested on each of four visits

location.where: Results, NEFA paragraph (pre-meal value of the 'from ... to ...' pair; Figure 1 pre-meal)

left_out.what: all post-meal and post-exercise values (NEFA, glucose, insulin, glycerol, 3-OHB; text and Figures 1-5), and fat/CHO oxidation rates (g/min) during exercise: the meals are given only as percentages of an unstated energy
glycerol, 3-OHB and insulin time points shown only in Figures 2, 3, 5
resting insulin 15.2 +/- 1.1 uU/mL (Results, insulin paragraph): text does not say whether it is the HGI visit or all visits
